name: platonia
description: Platonia — a terra do saber! App educacional com trilhas, biblioteca e certificados.

scripts.assets:generate: npm run assets:prepare && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --assetPath assets
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:app && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:app && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:app && npx cap add ios
scripts.build:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease
